title: Pointwise bound by the binary-function supremum norm
statement: For a real-valued function $f$ on the binary cube and any point $x$ in that cube, $|f(x)|$ is at most the supremum of $|f|$ over the cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the binary cube
$x$ is a point of the binary cube
